'''Yn'neell Lassurg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]], when she was stationed the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Yn'neell Lassurg was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter|''Galactic Starfighter'']], where she is the Reputation Vendor for [[Imperial Forward Command]].<ref name="TOR" />
